answer: Grading runs as a prediction market on the final grade. Each grader stakes weight on the consensus score it expects, and only those who backed the settled grade draw from the losing pool. A sybil ring that trellis its ballots onto one identical mark cannot profit from mutual agreement, since self-consistent stakes net zero against each other. To earn, a wallet must forecast the independent consensus better than the herd, and a wrong jetty of cloned votes just funds honest forecasters. The lotus of real signal is rewarded; parroted grades pay nothing.
